items.title: Charlie Hardy Interview, 1961-12-16
items.q: Well, there was Souchon, and there was Kleppinger, and there was a Sherman Pardue. Sherman Pardue played the guitar. And, uh, Bill Gibbons and myself, his father.

ctx.x: Yeah. Do you recall who they were?
Well, there was Souchon, and there was Kleppinger, and there was a Sherman Pardue.
